bibl.title: Περίψημα. A Question of Life and Death in a Private Letter from the Eastern Desert of Egypt.
bibl.seg: Adam Bülow-Jacobsen & Hélène Cuvigny, Περίψημα. A Question of Life and Death in a Private Letter from the Eastern Desert of Egypt.
Nicola Reggiani (ed.), Greek Medical Papyri Text, Context, Hypertext = ArchPF. Beiheft 40 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 161-172, fig.
bibl.note: O. Ka. La. Inv. 652. Letter from Apollonios to Leon, in relation with a woman called ἡ θρυοτιλτής (the rush-gatherer) who has been taken ill, apparently by the plague. - Annexe: περίψημα.
